bitcoin_articles.headline: Keefe Bruyette Adjusts Price Targets for Core Scientific and Other AI Infrastructure Miners
bitcoin_articles.summary: Keefe Bruyette trimmed price targets for several Bitcoin miners, including Core Scientific, as part of a sector-wide valuation reset for companies pivoting to AI hosting.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Keefe Bruyette Adjusts Price Targets for Bitcoin Miners in Sector-Wide Reset
bitcoin_articles.summary: Keefe Bruyette trimmed price targets for several Bitcoin mining companies, including TeraWulf, citing the need for increased valuation discipline in the AI hosting sector.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Continues Bitcoin Accumulation Strategy
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. has reached total holdings of 43,124 BTC as of late October 2026, following a series of significant acquisitions throughout the month.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Keefe Bruyette Adjusts Price Target for Cipher Digital
bitcoin_articles.summary: Keefe Bruyette reduced its price target for Cipher Digital from $28 to $11 as part of a sector-wide valuation reset for Bitcoin miners transitioning to AI infrastructure.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Keefe Bruyette Trims Price Targets for Bitcoin Miners Including Riot Platforms
bitcoin_articles.summary: Keefe Bruyette lowered price targets for several Bitcoin mining companies, including Riot Platforms, citing valuation concerns in the AI hosting sector.

bitcoin_articles.headline: Bitmine Immersion Technologies Reports Treasury Holdings of $14.5 Billion
bitcoin_articles.summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies announced that its total treasury holdings, including Ethereum, Bitcoin, cash, and strategic investments, reached $14.5 billion as of November 2, 2026.

bitcoin_articles.headline: The Smarter Web Company PLC Provides Update on Bitcoin Custody Arrangements
bitcoin_articles.summary: The Smarter Web Company PLC has issued an update regarding its Bitcoin treasury custody strategy, confirming the use of multiple institutional-grade providers and clarifying its relationship with Binance.
